name: PrivateGPT
tagline: Production-ready local document Q&A and ingestion pipeline built for 100% private offline RAG workflows.
real_test_summary: Tested ingesting local PDF and text documents using Ollama as the local backend. Exposes both a Gradio chat UI and OpenAI-compatible RAG API with zero external network traffic.
pros: Strict offline-first architecture designed for sensitive local documents
Provides both a built-in Gradio UI and OpenAI-compatible REST API
Modular support for Ollama, Llama.cpp, and local Qdrant vector storage
cons: Python environment setup requires careful dependency version matching
Slower document ingestion on CPU-only machines without GPU embeddings
